result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. The full suite passes offline (608 tests, 0 failures).

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/SupportTicketStore.java`**: `listOpenInRegion` now uses the same ordering as the sales-rep list. I moved that ordering into a shared constant, `PRIORITY_THEN_OLDEST_FIRST`, that both methods use, so the two can't drift apart. Closed tickets and other regions are still excluded as before.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/RegionManagerTest.java`**: added `openTicketsOfTheRegionListHighestPriorityFirstThenOldest`, which uses your example (T-1 to T-5 plus a closed high ticket and an other-region ticket) and expects `T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1`.

Nothing is committed.
